note: High-grade tea leaf used by Servants (ITEM_TEXT 616); 'Pekoe' is the tea grade. Same string is the ITEM_HELP/ITEM_TEXT mirror key.

Scroll; ITEM_TEXT 705 gives the archaic reading furugatari mutsu-sumeragi norito and says the 'land' kanji is misleading (it also reads mutsu = 'six'). The pun cannot survive in 20 bytes; 'Land-King' keeps the surface reading the description comments on. Tell the ITEM_TEXT translator.

en: Attacks one enemy row with fire.
Creates a barrier that blocks one drain attack. Can be stacked.
note: 'drain barrier' as in the battle messages.

en: High chance to instantly kill one enemy.
Rainbow light hits one enemy; stronger per spell cast this battle.
note: Compressed: 'grows according to the number of spells activated during the battle'.

en: Asks the gods to work a mighty miracle at the cost of one level.
Grants all allies the Inf Range status.
note: 'Inf Range' = UI status label for the infinite-range buff (ebt row 1047). Brackets dropped.

en: Lowers all enemies' spell resistance. Stackable.
Shows the map of every floor of the current dungeon.

note: Status names follow the UI list (Sleep/Poison/Paralysis/Silence/Confusion/Charm), capitalised; Japanese brackets dropped.
UI status label is 'Petrify'; noun form used for grammar.

en: Has a chance to revive one dead ally.
note: Lit. 'cures one ally's Death at a fixed chance'.

en: Cures one ally of Sleep, Silence, Confusion and Charm.
[Instrument] Lifts the curse on spirit and undead monsters.
note: [Instrument] tag as in the '?Instrument' unidentified name. Literal: removes the curse laid on spirit/undead monsters (a Dispel-type effect); kept literal.

en: [Instrument] High chance to put one enemy to sleep.
[Instrument] Raises all enemies' AC by 4. Stackable.
note: Higher AC is worse (Wizardry rule), so this weakens enemies, as in the battle message.

en: [Instrument] Blesses all allies' weapons so they can hit spirits.
[Instrument] High chance to charm one enemy.
[Instrument] Draws enemy attacks onto one ally.
note: Matches the 'marked for focused attacks' battle message.

en: [Instrument] A fissure damages foes; low chance to swallow them.
[Instrument] Resets stat changes made in battle for friend and foe.
note: 'all of friend and foe' compressed to 'friend and foe'.

en: [Instrument] Cures minor status ailments for all allies.
[Servant] Spends money to deal up to 100 damage to one enemy.
note: [Servant] = item used by a Servant via the Servant's Bag, as in HELP_TEXT.

en: [Servant] Spends money to deal up to 200 damage to one enemy.
[Servant] Spends all your money for limitless damage to one enemy.
Attacks one enemy with holy power.
Has a chance to inflict Poison on one enemy row.
Raises all allies' spell resistance. Stackable.
Raises an ally's number of attacks by 1. Stackable.
note: Source says only 'mikata no' (ally/allies), neither 'all' nor 'one'; the battle message for this buff has no 'everyone' form, so singular chosen. Uncertain.

en: [Instrument] Has a chance to confuse one enemy row.
The whole party rests until the next night or morning.
note: Lit. 'everyone rests and time advances to the next night or morning'.

en: Fully restores one ally's HP. Not for those with the Cook skill.
note: Compressed 'cannot be used on characters with the Cook skill' (skill name 'Cook' from UI) to fit 67.

en: Restores one ally's MP. Not for those with the Cook skill.
Restores one ally's SP. Not for those with the Cook skill.
note: Source has a trailing space; not reproduced.

en: Attacks one enemy row with freezing cold.
Knocks an enemy's gear loose, or steals an item it is carrying.
note: Monsters hold items as equipped or carried: Dropkick turns an equipped item into a carried one, or takes a carried one.

en: The whole party is guaranteed to escape from battle.

note: Not in glossary. chap slice_021 rows 1719-1720 use 'Radiant Rank of the Sun' (23 bytes, does not fit 18); chap slice_017 row 1398 calls the same item 'Light Rank'. Chose the Light Rank series form. Flag chap 1719/1720 for consistency.
Cut item (designer note: cut). 'Divine-Rank Sun Spirit' (22) does not fit.
Cut item. Star-rank Sun Spirit; 18 bytes, at the limit.
Hiragana kamudakara = archaic reading of 'sacred treasure'; dropped by Asunamuchi, who speaks archaically. Translated rather than romanised. New term.
Cut item. 'Stida' follows the Ryug crystal Aura Stida (ITEM row 666), not yet translated; align with whatever the ITEM slice chose. New name.
